title: Cold Calling Laws in the UAE: Can an AI Voice Agent Make the Call?
meta_description: Read on 30 September 2026: UAE Cabinet Resolution 56 of 2024 allows automated marketing calls from 9am to 6pm, from numbers on your own trade licence, never to the DNCR. Resolution 57 fines each breach up to AED 150,000.
secondary_keywords: can an ai voice agent make telemarketing calls in the uae
uae do not call registry dncr

image.takeaway: The UAE allows automated marketing calls from 9:00 am to 6:00 pm, never to a number on the Do Not Call Registry.
image.alt: Cold calling laws in the UAE: an AI voice agent may make the call, from 9am to 6pm, on your own licensed numbers, never to the DNCR
